title: Swing to Bop
release: Charlie Christian: Jazz Immortal (Esoteric); later The Immortal Charlie Christian
studio_context: Recorded at Minton's Playhouse, Harlem, by Jerry Newman on a portable disc recorder, 12 May 1941.

evidence.note: The date is jazzdisco.org's; the pianist is disputed (Kenny Kersey or Thelonious Monk).

drum_performances.name: Kenny Clarke
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The house drummer at Minton's on a record of the jam sessions bebop came out of, on brushes.

notable_moments.description: A strong quarter-note groove on brushes, 'big angular jabs with the snare drum and bass drum' (Bishop).

drums.description: Brushes: the ride rhythm on the snare, the bass drum feathered, big angular jabs on the snare and bass drum under Christian's solo.
